method: Run the tracked offline safety-scope verifier. It compiles and executes the complete Guard fence without provider or desktop calls, tests budget preflight/usage overrun, the observation threshold, default-deny action shape and one-time task/action-bound approval references, and checks lesson/metadata claim wording.

observations.model: static lesson and local policy model audit
observations.trace: Budget gate runs before provider call; actual overrun blocks the returned action; three adjacent equal comparisons stop on observation four; unknown action is denied; approval is task/action-bound and single-use.

limitations: The verifier exercises only the local teaching model. It does not call a provider, control a browser/desktop, verify screenshots/coordinates against a real UI, or execute business side effects.
Approval references are trusted-host inputs in the example; the code does not authenticate approvers, enforce expiry/revocation, or provide atomic consumption across processes.
No production IdP, app authorization, sandbox isolation, provider usage accounting, concurrent budget reservation, logging pipeline, or recovery path was tested.
